basic_details.job_title: NIFTEM Senior Accountant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management, Kundli (NIFTEM-K), an Institution of National Importance under the Ministry of Food Processing Industries, Government of India, has invited applications for one Senior Accountant post, purely on a contractual basis, in the Office of Dean (Research & Outreach / R&D). content_sections.heading: About NIFTEM
content_sections.text: NIFTEM-Kundli is described in the notice as an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Food Processing Industries, Government of India. The post advertised sits in the Office of Dean (Research & Outreach / R&D), which handles funded research and consultancy projects.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are sent by email to [email protected] . The subject line of the email must clearly state: Application for the post of Senior Accountant in Dean (R&O) Office. Download the application form from the website www.niftem.ac.in . Complete the form and attach the photograph, signatures and other documents. Email the application with the subject line given above to [email protected] . Make sure it is submitted by 6:00 PM on 12 November 2026. For any difficulty in submitting the application, the notice gives the number 0130-228-1020.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: 02 years of experience in Accounts and having prime knowledge of Tally & Computer Applications. Thorough knowledge of accounting software (e.g., Tally Prime/ERP 9), PFMS, and MS Excel/Office. Prior experience in Central/State Govt. Universities, IITs, NITs, autonomous institutes, or research organizations. Good understanding of GFR (General Financial Rules), GST, and TDS compliance. Maximum 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates as per Government of India rules. Qualifications, experience and the upper age limit are counted on the last date of receipt of applications. The minimum prescribed qualifications are the minimum only; the mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details. Duration: 12 months (Contractual; extendable based on performance). The position is purely contractual for the specified duration and co-terminus with the requirement of the Institute. The engagement confers no right or claim, explicit or implicit, to regular or permanent absorption/appointment in the institute.

content_sections.heading: NIFTEM Senior Accountant Job Description
content_sections.text: Maintaining complete accounts and ledgers for various funded research and consultancy projects under the Dean (R&O) office. Preparation and generation of project-related bills, vouchers, and sanction orders. Timely preparation and maintenance of Utilization Certificates (UC) and Statements of Expenditure (SOE) for funding agencies (DST, DBT, MoFPI, ICAR, etc). Reconciliation of project funds, grants-in-aid, and bank statements. Coordinating internal/external audits and handling financial documentation for project closures. Documenting financial transactions, and monitoring the efficiency of existing accounting procedures and ensuring they comply with government regulations. Reviewing financial documents to resolve any discrepancies and irregularities, and reconciling already documented reports, statements and various transactions. Creating, reviewing and presenting budgets, recommending financial actions by analyzing accounting options, cooperating with auditors in preparing audit reports, providing guidance on revenue enhancement, cost reduction and profit maximization. Preparing and analyzing financial statements like cash flow statement, balance sheet and profit and loss statement, and submitting annual tax returns.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application form with photograph and signatures. Other relevant documents. At the interview: original certificates and other relevant documents.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Only candidates shortlisted on merit, qualification and relevant experience will be called for the interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by SMS alert/email only. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Accountant posts has NIFTEM announced?
faq.answer: NIFTEM has announced one (01) Senior Accountant post in the Office of Dean (Research & Outreach / R&D) at NIFTEM-Kundli, on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIFTEM Senior Accountant post?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 12/11/2026 (12 November 2026), by 6:00 PM, at [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NIFTEM Senior Accountant?
faq.answer: M.Com / MBA (Finance) with minimum 50% marks and at least 2 years of relevant experience, OR B.Com with minimum 50% marks and at least 3 to 4 years of relevant experience in accounting/auditing.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NIFTEM Senior Accountant post?
faq.answer: The age limit is a maximum of 45 years, counted on the last date of receipt of applications. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates is as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NIFTEM Senior Accountant?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs. 45,000/- per month (Consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NIFTEM Senior Accountant post?
faq.answer: Download the application form from www.niftem.ac.in and email it with photograph, signatures and other documents to [email protected] by 6:00 PM on 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What should the email subject line be?
faq.answer: The subject line must clearly state: Application for the post of Senior Accountant in Dean (R&O) Office.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Only candidates shortlisted on merit, qualification and relevant experience will be called for the interview, by SMS alert or email.

faq.question: Q9. Is the NIFTEM Senior Accountant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely contractual for 12 months, extendable based on performance, and it gives no right or claim to regular or permanent absorption or appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
